ACT II OF 2008
ACT II OF 2008
PAKISTAN
INTERNATIONAL AIRLINE CORPORATION (SUSPENSION OF TRADE UNIONS AND EXISTING
AGREEMENTS) ORDER (REPEAL) ACT, 2008.
An Act to repeal the
Pakistan International Airline Corporation
(Suspension of Trade
Unions and Existing
Agreements) Order 2001
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part-I,
30th August, 2008]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 28th August, 2008, and
is hereby published for general information:--
Whereas it is expedient to repeal
the Pakistan International Airline Corporation (Suspension of Trade Unions and
Existing Agreements) Order, 2001 (C.E's Order No. 6
of 2001);
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1)
This Act may be called the Pakistan International Airline Corporation
(Suspension of Trade Unions and Existing Agreements) Order (Repeal) Act, 2008.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 28th August, 2008, and

Whereas it is expedient to repeal
the Pakistan International Airline Corporation (Suspension of Trade Unions and
Existing Agreements) Order, 2001 (C.E's Order No. 6
of 2001);
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Repeal of the Pakistan International
Airline Corporation (Suspension of Trade
Unions and Existing
Agreements) Order, 2001 (C.E's Order No. 6 or 2001).-(1) The Pakistan
International Airline Corporation (Suspension of Trade Unions and Existing
Agreements) Order 2001, (C.E's Order No. 6 of 2001)
is hereby repealed:
Provided that the trade unions,
associations, organizations or groups of any type of employees suspended under
the aforesaid Order shall be registered afresh in accordance with law.
(2) Notwithstanding the repeal of the C.
E's Order No. 6 of 2001, and without prejudice to the provisions of sections 6
and 24 of the General Clauses Act, 1897 (X of 1897), all administrative orders
issued, actions taken and modifications made in settlements shall continue in
force until altered or rescinded.
